title: DuSE-Bench: Benchmarking Joint Reasoning over Evolving Dialogue and Documents
abstract: arXiv:2611.00755v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Persistent Web information assistants must combine evolving document facts with user requirements established and revised across sessions. Yet systematic evaluation of how changes in both sources affect response requirements and evidence attribution remains limited. To address this gap, we introduce Dual-Source Evolution Benchmark (DuSE-Bench), a benchmark comprising 1,000 tasks across five scenarios, including 700 whose required premises originate in both dialogue and documents. An evolving Support Graph guides task construction and preserves links from updated facts and reused conclusions to original turns and passages. Task annotations distinguish grounding source from state dependence and enable separate evaluation of response content, response type, and source attribution. translated_title: DuSE-Bench：面向演化对话与文档联合推理的基准测试
translated_abstract: 持久的网络信息助手必须将不断演化的文档事实与跨会话中建立和修订的用户需求相结合。然而，对两个信息源的变化如何影响响应需求与证据归因的系统性评估仍然有限。为填补这一空白，我们提出了双源演化基准（DuSE-Bench），该基准包含五个场景下的1,000个任务，其中700个任务的所需前提同时来源于对话和文档。一个不断演化的支持图引导任务构建，并保留从更新事实和复用结论到原始对话轮次与文档段落的链接。任务标注区分了依据来源与状态依赖性，支持对响应内容、响应类型和来源归因的分别评估。在11种基线配置上的实验揭示了模型在演化对话与文档上进行联合推理时面临的持续挑战，联合任务上的内容准确率……
tldr: 该论文提出了DuSE-Bench基准，包含五个场景下的1,000个任务（其中700个任务的前提同时源于对话与文档），用于系统评估信息助手在演化对话与文档上的联合推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DuSE-Bench, a benchmark comprising 1,000 tasks across five scenarios (700 with premises originating from both dialogue and documents) to systematically evaluate AI assistants' joint reasoning over evolving dialogue and documents.
